ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from picking up a case that was already assigned to another agent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Join_Lead", $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Business_Admin", OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Fraud_Check", RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance" ), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), NOT(LEFT(OwnerId, 3) = "00G"), LEFT(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId), 3) = "005", PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) <> $User.Id )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The case has already been assigned to another agent, please pickup another case.
